title: Fact check on the review queue

body.title: Christmas Eve Eve, December 23
body.body:
Slow down and prepare your heart for Christmas with a special worship service.
Wednesday, December 23, 2026
Services at 5:30pm and 7:00pm
Invite family and friends
body.review_note: 5:30pm and 7:00pm are not in the email or on its flyers. Check the times before approving. The calendar already has “Christmas Eve Eve, December 23” that day at 5:00pm, and this says 5:30pm and 7:00pm. One of them is wrong. The reader was unsure: the text says 5:30pm and 7pm, the flyer says 5pm and 6:30pm.
